data.title: Ethereum reclaims $2,500 as exchange supply dro... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum has regained the $2,500 price level amid a significant 28% drop in ETH held on exchanges since May 2025, reducing the liquid supply available for trading. Increased staking, now at over 35%, further removes ETH from circulation, tightening supply. Additionally, U.S. Spot ETH ETFs have grown to $16.7 billion in assets, absorbing more ETH and limiting availability on open markets. This combination makes Ethereum's price more sensitive to spot demand, with future price stability depending on continued buyer interest versus potential selling pressure.
data.author: AMBCrypto
